description: Forward supports udpMode with normal and transparent values
steps: Call forward create API with udpMode=normal and verify it is persisted
Call forward update API with udpMode=transparent and verify it is persisted
Call forward list API and verify udpMode is returned for every forward

description: Control plane emits transparent UDP service config for udpMode=transparent
steps: Verify UDP service uses transparent listener and handler type

description: Node can apply and remove TPROXY routing policy automatically
steps: Send EnsureTProxyPolicy command to a Linux node
Verify iptables and policy routing entries are created idempotently

description: Non-Linux node rejects transparent UDP mode with actionable error
steps: Attempt to deploy transparent UDP to a non-Linux node
Verify deployment fails with a clear unsupported-platform error
Verify existing normal UDP service is not impacted

description: Loop prevention blocks self-capturing transparent UDP rules
steps: Create a transparent UDP forward that targets local listen endpoint
Verify control plane rejects the configuration before deploy
Verify no TPROXY policy is applied
